description: A delay that measures the time between triggers and plays back one trigger later, with a control to take a number of samples off that delay

params.text: Takes two to this power of samples off the delay, 0 to 16, so 1 sample at fully counter-clockwise and 65536 fully clockwise
Adds up to one more to the power the Pre knob sets, so the shortening moves smoothly between that knob's steps

inputs.text: The signal written into the delay
Sets the delay to the time since the last rising edge here, reading high above 2V and low again below 0.1V

outputs.text: 10V through the stretch of the cycle that the two knobs take off the delay, ending as the next trigger is due, and 0V the rest of the time
The input played back one trigger later, less the samples the two knobs take off

notes: the delay length is only measured when a trigger arrives at TRIG; before the second trigger the module uses its starting length of 4096 samples
the buffer holds about 256 seconds at 44.1kHz shared out between the polyphonic channels, so sixteen channels leave about sixteen seconds each

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
